listings.thesis: levered to AI-driven fab and HBM capacity additions; upside depends on order timing and export-control risk.

priorCase.rankRationale: Contrary to the prior 'no-news flush' read, the -14% was a Jefferies Underperform downgrade (€85 PT) attacking valuation and CPO step-change hopes, with stuck RF-SOI inventory and weak handsets pressuring FY27 fab loading. On the AI-node materials lens that is a real negative, warranting a step down.

listings.thesis: Engineered substrates are a hidden enabler for silicon photonics and RF; smaller cap with optical substrate optionality.

priorCase.rankRationale: On the CPO lens this is the most direct hit: Jefferies explicitly pushed back on the Co-Packaged-Optics step-change for Photonics-SOI (only 30-40% growth through FY30) while cutting to Underperform at €85 on an 85% peer premium. The 'hidden enabler' substrate thesis is challenged on its own terms; step down.
